name: Preston Fairmont
title: The Millionaire
ability:
Anytime you gain 1 or more resources from a card effect, place them on Family Inheritance instead of in your resource pool.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may spend 2 resources to automatically succeed, instead.
ability_cn:
每当你从一个卡牌效果获得1个或多个资源，不将其放在资源池，改为放在家族遗产上。
[elder_sign]效果：+0。你可以花费2资源来改为自动成功。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +0. You may spend 2 resources to automatically succeed, instead.
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果：+0。你可以花费2资源来改为自动成功。
flavor_text: "My money, my legacy, my problem. Let me handle it in my own way."
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Family Inheritance, Lodge "Debts," 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Illicit]] cards.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：流浪者([rogue])等级0-5，求生者([survivor])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：家族遗产、秘社"债务"、1张随机基础弱点。 牌组构建限制：无[[违法]]卡牌。
